# Build People

Build People is a United States recruitment partner supplying proven construction, mining and industrial professionals for project, site, plant and business environments.

## Services
- Context-led recruitment for construction, mining and industrial organisations
- Permanent placement of leaders, technical specialists and operations professionals
- Confidential career conversations and job opportunities for professionals

## Coverage
National United States coverage across construction, mining and industrial sectors, including high-rise, infrastructure, specialist equipment and industrial operations.
